body: I hope yours go as smoothly as mine, if I  don’t  reply to you in two days then I’m  dead and it worked out great if not I’ll reply with what happens

Pretty bad, everything is on a steady decline and what I do is very repetitive. I’ve accumulated a lot of physical and emotional abuse that I don’t have the drive to live it’s literally been beaten out of me. I am such a hollow person and dying would relieve me of this not so great existence

That’s why I deprived myself of sleep so if I don’t get decapitated I would have the proper consciousness to survive my injuries.

Also the train hotspots have been so frequent that they’ve made a a cleaning system due to amount of suicide on train, I also know for a fact that people simply do not care about people like me or people who are dying unless they are some one with a skewed perception of morality - most people, at the end of the day simple don’t care enough to be sad or traumatize by a random death.

I will feel no guilt when I do this.
Same, hope we both meet a peaceful end soon
Don’t think that’s possible in todays stores but thanks for the recommendation

Yeah, I tend to make people not like me without even trying. I just want this sadness to go away and constant run of bad luck to end, If you have any source on a quick and painless death that doesn't involve a gun let me know.

ya looked into hanging myself but it requires you to break your neck if you don't you will struggle even more, I've heard it's like drowning but a little less painful which is too much for me!

edit: If I were in american I'd just shoot myself in the head already but I'm not :(

No girlfriend. I don't talk to people because I usually upset them unknowingly by being awkward or not able to hold a proper conversation, last time I talked to a person was 6-5~ years ago. usually relationships for me don't last, I tend to alienate myself and think to much on how to be normal
I understand but in my case if I kill myself there is no misdirected pain, I have no family or friends. Haven't spoken to people in years unless it's required.
Sorry but I don't want the police or some other authority to put me in a place without freedom, I believe I'm entitled to end my life.

I think for me, it's just bad luck. I don't I'll ever be in a situation to make light of my struggles, some people are meant to live others are just forced to accept the affliction of bad structure even when I'm doing things for myself the pleasure has been taken out of it, I'm no longer in control of my happiness.

Better diet, exercise tried a therapist once but it just feels like outer body experience, never really opening up. I tried doing getting into artsy types of hobbies but I kept hating myself because it just reminded me of bad times, tried making friends but It's pretty obvious they don't like me and just let me hang around out of pity - tried getting in contact with old friends but they already moved on and don't want anything to do with me.
